title: Diagnostic Bundle
description: The user-exportable diagnostic bundle (the artifact a user may save and share for support). Per FR-191 (clarified 2026-08-07), this is a POSITIVE content boundary: only the fields enumerated below are permitted. Any field not listed here is excluded by default. No note content, titles, summaries, captions, file names/paths, window titles, credentials, passwords, key material, raw server responses, or remote object names appear in this bundle. Schema version 1.

osVersion.description: macOS version the bundle was generated on.

providerType.description: Sync provider type, or null if sync is unconfigured. NEVER the endpoint URL, hostname, or credentials.

recentErrorEvents.description: Normalized provider error events from the last 30 days. NEVER raw server responses or bodies.

syncRunCounts.description: Synchronization run counts and durations. NEVER payloads or object names.

objectCounts.description: Aggregate counts of notes / blocks / assets. NEVER titles, summaries, captions, or content.

vaultState.description: Vault state at generation time. NEVER the password or derived key.

permissionStatuses.description: Boolean granted-or-denied statuses for relevant system permissions.
